summary: Historical development and theoretical foundations of Chinese medicine

sections.title: Medical Origin Chapter One
sections.originalText: 医者，意也。意者，心之所之也。心有所之，谓之医。
sections.translation: Medicine means intention. Intention is what the mind holds. When the mind holds something, it is called medicine.
sections.interpretation: This chapter explores the philosophical foundation of medicine as the intention or will to heal.

keyConcepts.description: The philosophical foundation and ethical principles of medical practice
